operations.name: dm_feasible
operations.title: Principal-submatrix feasible family
operations.description: Enumerate all nonsingular principal subsets, apply the declared initial twist and bind the complete feasible family.

operations.name: dm_exchange_certificate
operations.title: Symmetric-exchange certificate
operations.description: Check every ordered pair of feasible sets and every element of their symmetric difference.

operations.name: dm_exchange_witness
operations.title: Concrete exchange alternatives
operations.description: List every allowed second element for the declared extremal feasible-pair witness, including equal elements.

operations.name: dm_twist
operations.title: Subset twist and reversal
operations.description: Apply symmetric difference with the declared subset and record exact reversal.

operations.name: dm_dual
operations.title: Full-ground dual certificate
operations.description: Complement every feasible set and bind lower/upper rank duality and involution.

operations.name: dm_loop_complement
operations.title: Single-element loop complementation
operations.description: Toggle the declared family membership rule and retain its exact involution and exchange check.

operations.name: dm_width
operations.title: Feasible-size width profile
operations.description: Return minimum and maximum feasible cardinalities and the full seven-bin histogram.

operations.name: dm_parity
operations.title: Uniform-parity classification
operations.description: Distinguish a single parity of feasible cardinalities from equal cardinality or all-even cardinality.

operations.name: dm_distance
operations.title: Nearest feasible subsets
operations.description: Enumerate every nearest feasible set under exact symmetric-difference distance.

operations.name: dm_lower_matroid
operations.title: Lower-matroid bases
operations.description: Return minimum-cardinality feasible sets with an exact basis-exchange certificate.

operations.name: dm_upper_matroid
operations.title: Upper-matroid bases
operations.description: Return maximum-cardinality feasible sets with an exact basis-exchange certificate.

operations.name: dm_deletion
operations.title: Deletion with coloop convention
operations.description: Delete the declared element using the explicit coloop contraction-equivalent convention.

operations.name: dm_contraction
operations.title: Contraction with loop convention
operations.description: Contract the declared element using the explicit loop deletion-equivalent convention.

operations.name: dm_relabel
operations.title: Permutation covariance
operations.description: Relabel all feasible sets by the declared bijection and verify inverse restoration and width.

operations.name: dm_vertex_orbit
operations.title: Six vertex-flip operations
operations.description: Record the six twist/loop words and check their involution, braid and order-three relations.

operations.name: dm_minor_commutation
operations.title: Distinct-element minor order
operations.description: Compare deletion-then-contraction with the reverse order, preserving the exact resulting families.

operations.name: dm_nullity_distance
operations.title: Principal nullity and set distance
operations.description: Compare principal-submatrix nullity with distance after transporting the initial twist.

operations.name: dm_explanation
operations.title: Accessible structural explanation
operations.description: Represent finite counts while preserving human and assistive-technology review gaps.

operations.name: dm_observation_gap
operations.title: Real-domain observation reservation
operations.description: Keep missing real observations, participants, calibration and independent review explicit.

operations.name: dm_authority_gate
operations.title: Consequential authority reservation
operations.description: Keep real consequential actions held pending competent and affected authority.
